title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E20 — Double Cheeseburger, Hold the Diploma
P.J. threatens to discharge Mark when his student, Earvin, quits school. Geneva can't afford to buy a new bicycle for her daughter, Nicole.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E21 — Groom and Doom
Mark introduces Geneva to a college teacher who asks her to marry him.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E22 — Hangin' with Mrs. Cooper
Mark plots to reunite his parents after his mother, Dorothy (Ja'net DuBois), leaves her husband of 35 years and moves in with Mark. Richard Roundtree guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E1 — Call Me Irresponsible
Mark avoids P.J.'s phone calls and learns, too late, that she had good news. Geneva plays a trick on Vanessa to teach Nicole a lesson.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E2 — My Bodyguard
Mark teaches Tyler how to be a tough guy so that he can protect Nicole against a bully at school. When Tyler's approach doesn't work, Geneva goes up to the school and makes a big scene, scaring the bully away. Vanessa takes care of her boss' prized orchid.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E3 — Between Friends
Mark and a former college buddy embark upon an all-out competition--first with wrestling, then with women. Vanessa finally manages to get a job answering phones at a doctor's office.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E4 — He Said, She Said
Geneva fights with the video store clerk who claims that she never returned the "Mrs. Doubtfire" tape. When Mark breaks up with a woman he was dating from Vanessa's carpool, Vanessa is kicked out.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E5 — Matinee
When he takes Nicole and her friends to the theater, Mark disrupts the movie. Geneva makes 300 penguins for the school's decoration committee.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E3 — Everybody Hates Homecoming
Chris is on cloud nine when a cute girl, Jenise Huckstable, invites him to the Tattaglia Homecoming Dance. However, his nerves take a turn for the worse when her father, Dr. Huxtable, wants Chris to come over to the house to meet him before the dance.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E4 — Everybody Hates the English Teacher
When Julius and Rochelle decide to raise Mr. Omar's rent, Mr. Omar demands they bring the apartment up to code and moves in with Chris' family until the repairs are done.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E5 — Everybody Hates My Man
Chris realizes that by helping the school's star running back and his friends with homework he is allowed to hang out with the cool kids. Greg tries to make him see that it's a bad idea.
